note: Gate guard barks (authored, not LLM). Keys are what the checkpoint and the guard brain ask for; a line is picked at random per key. Generic, in-world, no franchise terms.

wave: You're clear. Keep your nose clean.
search: Papers. And arms out, you're getting searched.
Stop there. Search, then you go.
night_hostile: You've got a face we're looking for. Lucky for you it's dark and I'm bored.
After curfew, wanted, and at my gate. Make it worth my while.
halt_hostile: Halt! Hands where I can see them!
warn: One more step and you're paste.
cleared_search: Nothing. Get out of my sight.
bribe_taken: Pleasure. Now you were never here.
no_credits: That's not enough to buy a nap.
Come back when you've got real coin.
mouth_off: Oh, a comedian. Now it's a search.
downed: Drag that one to the pit. Lighten their pockets first.
spot_check: Papers are fine. Turn out your pockets.
confiscated: Smart. Now get out of my sight.
Confiscated. Don't let me see it again.
